quests.name: Slime Trouble
quests.brief: Sela's cellar smells of slime. Thin the forest's supply of them.
quests.accepted: Three fewer slimes in the world and there's coin in it for you.
quests.completed: The cellar thanks you. So does my nose. Here - you've earned it.

quests.name: The Cheese Run
quests.brief: Bram wants a cheese wheel. Of course he does.
quests.accepted: One wheel. Uncut. I'll know if you nibbled.
quests.completed: Magnificent. Roll on, friend. Roll on.

quests.name: Wolf Watch
quests.brief: Ana's ankles have opinions about the road wolves.
quests.accepted: Two of the big ones, gone. Then I'll walk where I please.
quests.completed: I walked the whole road today and nothing bit me. Take this.

quests.name: The Troll Toll
quests.brief: Something under the Deepwood charges travelers in teeth.
quests.accepted: It squats where the old road bends. Mind your kneecaps.
quests.completed: The road east breathes easier. The village remembers this.

quests.name: A First Brew
quests.brief: Vex wants proof you can work a cauldron before she trusts you with the good stuff.
quests.accepted: One health potion, brewed by your own hand: a forest herb, a marsh reed, my cauldron. Then we talk.
quests.completed: Not bad for a first brew. Here - the good stuff, brewed proper.

quests.name: A Shield of Reeds
quests.brief: Hilda wants to see you work the forge before she calls you a smith.
quests.accepted: Three marsh reeds, woven tight, at my forge. Make me a buckler and keep it - it's yours.
quests.completed: Tight weave. You'll do. Take this for the reeds.

steps.text: Ask Sela at the inn for work
steps.hint: Sela at the inn always has a job going. Start there - a hero has to eat.

steps.text: Flatten three slimes in the fields east of town, then see Sela
steps.hint: Slimes nest in the fields east of the town gate. Three of them, and Sela pays.

steps.text: Clear the Mossy Cellar, the mountain's first floor
steps.hint: The gate to the Ashen Mountain stands north of town, past the bridge. The first floor is only a cellar.

steps.text: Brew a first potion at Vex's cauldron
steps.hint: Vex behind the BREWS door will show you the cauldron. Potions you brew cost you a herb, not a fortune.
Below the woods lies the Barrow Crypt. The dead there don't stay down without help.
Orcs hold the old watchtower now. Floor five. Bring potions.

steps.text: Bring a settler home to Pixelheim
steps.hint: Iva the healer waits in the Mirefen, and Wren hunts the fields east of town. Help one of them, and they'll come and live here.

steps.text: Fund the street lamps at the board on the square
steps.hint: The board on the square lists what Pixelheim needs next. Lamps first: some coin and three marsh reeds.
The golems of the Sunken Forge still work the bellows for no one. Floor seven.
Wyverns nest in the Stormcrag Aerie, one floor below the dragon. Mind the sky.

steps.text: Slay Fafnyr on the Ashen Throne (floor 10)
steps.hint: Fafnyr sleeps on the hoard at the top of the mountain. Ten floors up. End it.

steps.text: Set Fafnyr's scale in a fountain on the square
steps.hint: Fafnyr's scale belongs on the square, where everyone can see it. The board will tell you what else the fountain takes.

steps.text: Take the stair below the hoard: clear the Sunless Stair (floor 11)
steps.hint: You beat the dragon. Then you've seen the stair behind its hoard. That's where the whispers come from.
Deeper still, a vault the dead keep for their master. Mind the chests that bite.

steps.text: Cast down Morvax on the Throne of the Deathless (floor 15)
steps.hint: Morvax was one of us once, a hero of Pixelheim. Whatever he is now, it ends at the bottom.

mainQuest.done: Pixelheim is safe. The mountain is quiet, and the tavern isn't.
